title: Zaowuyun Raises Angel from Linear Capital for AIGC + 3D Marketing Content
summary: On May 4, 2023, Hangzhou Zaowuyun (造物云) — AIGC + 3D content for brands/ecommerce/design firms — closed an angel led by Linear Capital, and launched what it calls the world’s first AIGC+3D fused high-quality creation product (text/image/video modalities) for low-cost, high-volume
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · May 15, 2023

On May 4, 2023, Hangzhou Zaowuyun (造物云) — AIGC + 3D content for brands/ecommerce/design firms — closed an angel led by Linear Capital, and launched what it calls the world’s first AIGC+3D fused high-quality creation product (text/image/video modalities) for low-cost, high-volume product marketing content.

Founded 2021 as online 3D marketing design platform: thousands of virtual studios, materials, motion templates, 3D models — browser-based commercial-photo-grade 3D image/video. Team from Zhejiang University CS; AI-assisted product design since 2017; AIGC / Web3D / cloud render / vision. Clients: Haier, Tmall, Saky, De Gao Shentong, China Sports Lottery, etc.

Four product lines: (1) AI Product Photography — upload + scene/style/model or prompt → people–product–place comps; (2) AI Photo·3D — generative UX; brand asset library → white-bg / promo / scene shots; (3) AI Marketing Copy — GPT fine-tuned for platform-style batch copy; (4) AI Video — 3D synth brand-tone clips (e.g. 1,000+ SKU 15s TVC-class sets previously unaffordable). Thesis: AI + 3D photoreal + cloud + SaaS remake consumer/architecture/manufacturing/media design.

— END —
